layout_notes.text: SMB (DO-214AA) mounting pad layout (p5): pad height 2.18 mm (0.086 in) min, pad width 1.52 mm (0.060 in) min, gap between pads 2.159 mm (0.085 in) max, overall length 5.59 mm (0.220 in) ref.
SMB body: 4.06-4.57 mm long (excluding leads), 3.30-3.94 mm wide, 2.13-2.44 mm high; 5.21-5.59 mm over leads. Cathode band on the cathode end.
PPPM rating assumes 0.2 x 0.2 in (5.0 x 5.0 mm) copper pads to each terminal.

gaps: Datasheet gives no pin numbers, only cathode (band) and anode; pin numbers K and A here are labels, map to the symbol by name.
Marking code for SMBJ15A is LM (unidirectional) per p2; not a rating, recorded here only.

SMBJ15A-E3/52: E3 = RoHS commercial grade, 52 = 7 in reel of 750 (p1, p3); not AEC-Q101 (that is HE3/HM3).
